description: extractEmail(text) results. `email` = a full address was heard. `clarify` = something email-like was heard but a character is missing or ambiguous; the host should ask, never guess. Clarifications are only reported when the utterance mentions email/mail/address, so ordinary speech containing 'at' is ignored.
